scope: Reader overview and relocation of the historical map only; no new execution evidence or gates.
reader_paragraphs: What TR010 and TR010 R explain

TR010 explains the design: how a system checks recorded permission before an operation and detects changes to a protected package. TR010-R is its results companion: what was tested, what happened and what remains unproven. Together they let readers examine the method and its evidence, rather than accept a claim of success alone. [E01, E26]

The central question is simple: does preparing a dataset mean it may now be used? The answer is no. Readiness, recorded permission and intact files are different checks. A valid signature does not establish legal rights or human authority. [E01, E07]
Synthetic dataset → one-operation authorization → sealed package → valid dry run and rejection tests → verification report
This is an isolated software test, not the full Path 1-3 workflow. It starts with an already prepared synthetic dataset and registry. [E04, E08]
Synthetic dataset. Four made-up records let reviewers test the controls without using the historical paper corpus or client data.
One-operation authorization. A signed test record names one permitted operation. It is not permission for every possible use of the data.
Sealed package. A separate signing key binds the package's file list and hashes so that altered contents can be detected.
Valid dry run and rejection tests. A correctly bound package passes the dry run without loading a model. Separate wrong-scope and tampering cases must stop; rejection is their expected result.
Verification report. The report records the nine detailed outcomes and file identities. This five-part overview groups those steps; it adds no test or approval. [E04, E08]

TR007 explains dataset passports, origins, containment and controlled lifecycle movement. TR008 explains signal exchange and routing. TR009 explains session-bound governance evidence and its limits. TR010 strengthens the checks between prepared data and a named operation; TR010-R shows the verification evidence and comparison with v1.0. This is a progression of ideas, not a command sequence. [E01, E26]

Keep the three views separate. The flow above explains the current test. TR007-TR010 explains the paper background. Appendix B records the historical July release milestones. Neither the flow nor the milestone arrows grant permission, establish lawyer review or introduce new release gates.
